text.description_html:
Weslock 6681/6202, Double Cylinder Woodward I Handleset

This modern handleset made by Weslock is distinguished by the square mounts and sleek design. It is bold enough to make a contemporary statement yet simple enough to melt seamlessly into almost any decor. Available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, the contemporary Modern Woodward I Double Cylinder Handleset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entry sets are most often used on doors located near a window. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob/lever from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Woodward I Single Cylinder Handleset
Woodward I Dummy Handleset

This modernly styled handleset is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Weslock Modern Woodward I Double Cylinder Entryset:

  • Material: solid brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with 2-1/8" top (1-5/8" optional) and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Elegance Collection Modern Woodward I Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18-1/4"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
